about_the_game:
Step into the scales of an alligator in ALGATRAZ, where the prison’s most unexpected resident roams free. Seen as neutral by guards and staff, you decide your path—explore the sprawling prison grounds, uncover hidden secrets, assist in guard duties, or unleash chaos on detainees and staff alike.

Inspired by the viral sensation of Alligator Alcatraz, ALGATRAZ drops you into a dynamic prison environment where every corner holds potential for discovery or destruction. Engage with a cast of characters, from wary prisoners to unsuspecting guards, each reacting to your actions in unique ways. Dig into mysteries buried within the prison walls, lend a scaly claw to maintain order, or simply wreak havoc—there are no rules unless you choose them. Whether you’re slithering through cellblocks or snapping at troublemakers, this is your prison playground to shape as you see fit.

Key Features:

  • Play as an alligator in a one-of-a-kind prison setting

  • Complete freedom to explore, interact, or disrupt at your whim

  • Dynamic reactions from prison staff and detainees based on your choices

  • Hidden clues and secrets to uncover for the curious

  • No mandatory missions—play your way, at your pace

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600, 3.3 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X, 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti (Maxwell or newer), 2 GB or AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum System Requirements may change.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600K, 3.9 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X, 3.7 GHz or Greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070, 8 GB or AMD Radeon RX 590, 8 GB or Greater
  • DirectX: Version 11
